items.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Retention Domain
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Are you an experienced backend developer with a curious mindset? Do you have a passion for building intuitive, cutting-edge solutions with state-of-the-art technology? At LeoVegas, we’re on a mission to deliver the greatest iGaming experience to our customers and technology is at the heart of making that happen. As part of our Retention domain, you’ll play a key role in developing the platforms and features that keep players engaged and coming back for more. This is a great opportunity to join a fast-moving, flat-structured team as a Senior Backend Engineer, where your work will directly shape value-generating features across our products. The Retention team powers the organisation with communication capabilities, ranging from indirect and direct communication with the players to a custom-built toolbox that enriches the player journey with bonuses, loyalty programs, and seamless cross-channel experiences. As one of the most crucial parts of the player lifecycle, the Retention domain ensures our players return for new, exciting, and rewarding experiences. We’re driven by excellence and fuelled by innovation now we’re looking for someone who wants to be part of that journey. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Building scalable, robust and efficient solutions in our full-stack team and ensure the continuous delivery in our microservice architecture. - Being involved in technical discussions to challenge, propose, evaluate, and take a guiding and supportive approach to business needs. - Working closely with our operational units and stakeholders. - Driving your own initiatives with a high-quality mindset. - Working within the full chain of development, having end-to-end responsibilities. - Collaborative work across the organisation with other domains. - Making sure our IT ecology is scalable and ready for upcoming expansions. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - Minimum of 6+ years of experience working as a back-end developer with Java and/or Kotlin - Experience with messaging tools (i.e. Kafka) - Experience with microservice architecture - You have experience with common Java frameworks such as Spring and JPA - MySQL relational databases are not something new for you - Experience with AI tools like Claude NICE TO HAVES - Experience with OpenAPI - Experience with BigQuery - Experience with Kubernetes WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the iGaming industry. We’re a team of almost 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid work policy (3 days a week from the office) - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Benefits package - 800 PLN net (B2B)/gross (UOP) monthly with access to the cafeteria platform (private medical care, insurances, sports card) - Training budget - ICAS assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments. - Our office provides complimentary snacks and drinks; on Mondays, we serve complimentary breakfast. - Team and office social events throughout the year - Free parking for bicycles and motorcycles - Free gym in the building - Equipment: MacBook Pro + smartphone (iPhone 16/17 or Samsung Galaxy S25) JOIN US! In our pride, we like to empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait around for things to happen. We pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: CRM Manager - Reactivation
items.description: Betsson Group is looking for a self-driven and detail-oriented CRM expert with a "can-do" attitude to join our Global CRM & Engagement department . This is an excellent opportunity to be part of a team of CRM enthusiasts dedicated to driving customer engagement and reactivation. The role involves end-to-end management of reactivation lifecycle campaigns and communications across multiple brands, markets, and products. The primary focus is on winning back inactive customers and nurturing this segment to reduce repeated churn , directly impacting key performance indicators (KPIs). Key Responsibilities: Customer Communication & Campaigns: Execute hyper-segmented reactivation campaigns to engage inactive customers and minimize churn. Project Management: Utilize JIRA for efficient task and project management while ensuring seamless communication with stakeholders. Automation & Scalability: Implement automated campaign journeys to improve operational efficiency and campaign reach. CRM Budget Management: Leverage advanced prediction modeling to allocate budget effectively, optimizing investment in high-value customer segments. Campaign Optimization: Continuously refine and test audience segmentation and reward structures to maximize profitability. Analysis & Reporting: Conduct campaign performance analysis , measure ROI, and refine lifecycle offers for improved customer engagement. Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for enhancement within CRM operations and implement solutions to drive efficiency. Localization & Compliance: Tailor CRM strategies to align with market-specific regulations, trends, and competitor activity . Collaboration: Work closely with Customer Support to enhance customer journeys and reduce unnecessary support requests. Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular updates and insights to senior stakeholders on reactivation campaign success and customer behavior . On-Call Support: Participate in a rotational on-call schedule to manage any reactivation campaign-related incidents outside regular working hours. Required Experience & Skills: Minimum 4 years of CRM experience, ideally in the iGaming industry . Experience working in a multi-brand, multi-jurisdiction environment. Strong understanding of player segmentation, bonuses, and incentives . Ability to interpret CRM data and translate insights into actionable strategies. Proficiency in CRM tools and email marketing platforms , such as Salesforce or Xtremepush . Strong project management skills , with the ability to handle multiple campaigns at once. Results-driven mindset with a strong focus on customer engagement. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English . Additional Preferred Skills: Proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, Greek, Latvian or Polish is a plus. Passion for online casino, poker, and sportsbook betting products . CHALLENGE ACCEPTED? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.title: Software Engineer, Security Agents
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ROLE OVERVIEW Ready to build AI agents that revolutionize enterprise security? The North Security team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to create autonomous systems that handle the complex, critical tasks security practitioners face every day. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES As a Senior Software Engineer focused on agentic security, you'll build intelligent systems that empower security teams. Your responsibilities will include: - Build autonomous security agents that perform alert triage, secure code reviews, threat modeling, and vulnerability assessment - Develop agent orchestration systems that help security practitioners automate repetitive security tasks - Design and implement agent security controls to ensure our AI agents can safely interact with sensitive enterprise data - Create the security infrastructure that allows agents to operate in high-trust environments with stringent deployment requirements - Ship production-ready agent capabilities that run efficiently in resource-constrained environments - Research and implement novel security patterns for AI agent systems, sometimes requiring custom solutions where standard libraries fall short - Conduct security testing of both the agents you build and the platform that runs them. QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping user-facing security features - Strong Python development skills with significant production experience - Experience building or working with autonomous systems, AI agents, or intelligent automation - Solid understanding of security principles including session management, authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices - Ability to think about security at multiple layers: application security, agent behavior security, and infrastructure security - Comfortable working across the full stack and diving into unfamiliar codebases to understand and fix issues - Thrive in fast-paced environments where you can adapt to evolving priorities - Excited about the intersection of AI/ML and security engineering. WORKING LOCATION This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
items.description: At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. For 10 years, Scale has provided the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and has helped enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. Scale's internship is not a side project. Interns own real, shipped work on the same roadmaps as full-time engineers, with mentorship from world-class talent and a culture that values ownership, speed, and truth-seeking. Many of our interns return as full-time Scaliens. Scale’s rapidly growing Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. Our core work consists of: Creating custom AI applications that will impact millions of citizens Generating high-quality training data for national LLMs Upskilling and advisory services to spread the impact of AI Example Projects: Build reinforcement learning and post-training data pipelines that power frontier model development Develop evaluation infrastructure that measures model reliability for enterprise and public sector customers Ship agentic AI applications and the tooling that makes them observable, testable, and safe to deploy Ship tools that accelerate the growth of new qualified contributors on Scale's platform Build fraud-detection systems that remove bad actors and keep Scale's contributor base safe and trusted Use models to estimate the quality of tasks and contributors, and guarantee quality on requests at large scale Devise advanced matching algorithms that pair contributors to customers for optimal turnaround and accuracy Create optimized and efficient UI/UX tooling, in combination with ML algorithms, for 100k+ contributors completing billions of complex tasks Develop new AI infrastructure products to visualize, query, and explore Scale data Requirements: A graduation date in Fall 2027 or Spring 2028 with a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field (Computer Science, EECS, Computer Engineering, Statistics) Available for a Summer 2027 internship (May/June start dates) Product engineering experience such as building web apps full-stack, integrating with relevant APIs and services, talking to customers, figuring out 'what' to build and then iterating Previous Computer Science/Software Engineering internship experience Track record of shipping high-quality products and features Experience building systems that process large volumes of data Experience with Python, Typescript, React, and/or MongoDB Please reference the job posting's subtitle for where this position will be located. Nice to have: Hands-on experience with LLMs, evaluations, or agentic systems — whether from coursework, research, or personal projects Open source contributions or a portfolio of shipped side projects How we work: Our credos shape how we make decisions and work as a team: Earn Customer Love — trust is earned with every interaction, every delivery, and every problem we solve Team Flow — ideas, energy, and support move freely across teams; optimize for the whole Quality is Our Cheat Code — the systems that deliver quality consistently are a structural advantage Find the 20% — find the inputs that drive the outcomes and execute them completely Write the Market — our research puts us at the frontier, and we bring our partners there first Three Moves Ahead — consider the consequences of consequences, and plan accordingly For those applying based in Qatar: Residency and employment in Qatar requires certain permissions (visa and permits) issued by the Qatari authorities. As part of the application process, candidates will be asked to provide personal information, including residency status and nationality, which is required for visa processing. This information is collected solely for immigration compliance purposes and will be not used as a criterion in any hiring decision unless such use is lawfully permitted. Visa issuance is at the discretion of the Qatari authorities. If you are successful in your application, you will be required to provide the documentation requested by Scale and the authorities to obtain the necessary permissions for you to live and work in Qatar, and Scale will work with successful candidates to support the visa application process. PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants. About Us: At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications. We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@scale.com. Please see the United States Department of Labor's Know Your Rights poster for additional information. We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision . PLEASE NOTE: We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our privacy policy for additional information.

items.title: Chief Legal Officer / Head of Legal
items.description: We are looking for an experienced CLO / Head of Legal to take ownership of the legal function within an international iGaming business operating across multiple markets. This is a business-oriented leadership role covering licensing, corporate matters, contracts, compliance, data protection, and legal risk management. The Head of Legal will work directly with senior management and help turn regulatory requirements and legal risks into practical solutions that support business growth. Responsibilities - Lead legal and regulatory support across existing and new markets, including iGaming license applications, renewals and expansion, regulatory reporting, communication with authorities, and coordination with local legal advisers - Assess requirements for new jurisdictions, covering gambling regulation, local presence, taxation, advertising and promotions, while monitoring legislative changes and translating them into practical requirements for the business - Oversee the group’s corporate structure, including entity incorporation and maintenance, ownership changes, intercompany arrangements, substance matters, and related KYC and tax considerations in cooperation with the CFO - Support relationships with banks, EMIs, and corporate service providers, including account opening and ongoing corporate and compliance matters - Own the full contracting function across gaming and payment providers, aggregators, KYC/anti-fraud and SaaS vendors, affiliates, media partners, employment/B2B relationships, NDAs, and IP matters; develop standardized templates and internal approval procedures - Oversee AML/CFT, KYC/KYB, sanctions compliance, GDPR and other applicable data protection requirements, working closely with the MLRO, Security, and relevant business teams - Provide legal oversight of responsible gaming requirements and customer-facing documentation, including Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policies, bonus terms, promotional rules, age restrictions, and self-exclusion - Manage legal disputes and asset protection matters, including player claims, ADR, regulatory complaints, chargebacks, payment-provider disputes, debt recovery, trademarks, domains, phishing, and unauthorized brand use - Coordinate external law firms and advisers, managing scope, quality, and legal spend, as well as budgets related to licensing and registration - Build and develop the internal Legal function through hiring, mentoring, and allocation of responsibilities, while acting as a business partner to executive leadership and providing practical solutions alongside legal risk assessments Requirements - 5+ years of hands-on legal practice in the iGaming sector, whether within an operator, platform provider, or industry-focused law firm; at least 2 years should include responsibility for leading the legal function or working independently as the sole in-house lawyer - A completed university-level legal education and a strong foundation in cross-border corporate and private international law, including international structures, conflict-of-law principles, jurisdiction and governing-law matters, and international contractual arrangements - Practical exposure to the regulatory side of online gambling, with a clear understanding of operator obligations and licensing frameworks such as Curaçao, Malta, Anjouan, or comparable jurisdictions - Strong knowledge of the commercial and legal specifics of iGaming, including contractual relationships with gaming and payment providers and the regulatory implications associated with bonus mechanics - Proven competence in AML/KYC and GDPR matters as they apply specifically to online gambling operations - Extensive contract ownership experience: able to independently prepare documentation, assess legal terms, negotiate directly with counterparties, and bring agreements through to completion - Ability to operate effectively when legislation or regulatory guidance does not provide a straightforward answer, assessing legal exposure while finding solutions that remain workable for the business - Languages proficiency: C1+ English for independent work in an international legal environment, including negotiations, contract drafting and correspondence; fluent/native Russian for effective communication with the team, key stakeholders and management. Would be a plus - First-hand involvement in taking an iGaming licence from initial application through to approval - Experience advising on the legal aspects of cryptocurrency-based payment flows - Familiarity with the rules governing gambling advertising and promotion across relevant jurisdictions - Professional qualification or admission to legal practice in one of the applicable jurisdictions What's in it for you - A senior-level role with the opportunity to influence decisions around new markets, products, and the broader business strategy - Freedom to build the Legal function around your own approach, defining its structure, internal processes, and future team setup - Flexible working arrangements with a choice between remote and hybrid formats, plus relocation assistance where needed - Resources to engage external legal expertise when required, alongside support for continuous professional development through training, certifications, and industry events - Competitive compensation tailored to the candidate’s experience and discussed individually during the hiring process - Paid vacation and sick leave, as well as compensation for work equipment

items.title: Associate II, Product Operations
items.location_text: United Kingdom, Brazil, Ireland, Colombia, Argentina, Cyprus, Portugal, Lithuania, Canada, Mexico
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Krak is Kraken's consumer banking and payments product — a fast-moving team building the card, payments, and financial features that bring crypto to everyday life. The Krak Product Operations team sits at the heart of this, making sure the business can move quickly without getting blindsided by compliance, risk, vendor, or operational dependencies. This is one of two roles in Krak’s Product Ops function, reporting to the Manager, Product Ops - Krak. You'll bring leadership to the day-to-day, working directly with compliance, legal, fraud, client engagement (CE), and external vendors to make sure new features land safely and successfully. THE OPPORTUNITY Product Ops at Krak is a co-ordination and intelligence function. Your job is to make sure that the cross-functional dependencies that could slow or derail delivery are surfaced early, actively managed, and resolved. You'll also help the team make better product decisions by curating the right operational data and bringing market and vendor intelligence into the room. You'll work across four areas: compliance and risk co-ordination, third party vendor management, responding to management information (MI) and feature performance, and strategic market intelligence. Your job is to make sure the right conversations happen at the right time, and that nothing falls through the cracks on the way to launch. Compliance & risk co-ordination - Maintain live, product-specific trackers of open compliance and legal items, including DRIs, status, and upcoming milestones - Triage new features against regulatory requirements ahead of development; ensure sign-off is built into delivery milestones - Work closely with fraud leads to ensure fraud controls and risk/velocity rules are factored into feature design (card, third party payments, and others) - Ensure fraud and CE teams are operationally positioned - with the right tooling, admin access, battlecards, and support articles - ahead of new product and feature launches - Support incident response for product-related issues and ensure post-incident reviews feed into product changes Third party vendor management - Maintain product-specific vendor trackers covering status, open actions, key contacts, and upcoming milestones - Own the cadence for performance reviews with key vendors and track actions to closure - Maintain a working view of vendor roadmaps and capabilities; produce periodic briefings on where vendor developments create product opportunities or constraints Responding to MI & feature performance - Ensure experiments and feature launches are supported by readily available fraud, dispute, and CE metrics alongside commercial KPIs - Interpret fraud, dispute, CE, and auth/decline data to identify emerging issues and surface them to the right teams - Drive follow-through on cross-functional findings - whether that's a compliance flag or a vendor issue Strategic market intelligence - Scan the market for competitors' changes to features, pricing, and risk positioning - Monitor regulatory and market developments that could affect the Krak roadmap - Identify third party vendor capabilities that could enable features not yet on the roadmap; flag where the current stack may be a constraint WHAT YOU BRING - 3-5 years experience in a product operations, strategy, or programme management role in a consumer fintech, payments, or banking business - ideally at a company with a card or payments product - Strong working knowledge of the regulatory and compliance landscape for consumer financial products in one of more regions - Experience working alongside or within fraud and risk functions; understanding of how fraud controls interact with product design - Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams with different stakeholders and different cadences, without dropping the ball - Track record of turning complex operational data into clear, actionable MI for product and leadership teams - Structured thinker who's comfortable in the detail but can step back and see the bigger picture - Strong communicator - able to translate between the worlds of compliance, risk, engineering, and product NICE TO HAVES - Experience with card issuing programmes (scheme rules, chargeback processes, fraud typologies) - Familiarity with third party banking and payments vendors (e.g. BIN sponsors, scheme processors, TPP aggregators) - Prior experience in a fast-scaling consumer fintech or neobank - Exposure to crypto or digital assets products Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Stay connected Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/krakenfx Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/ Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.kraken.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice

items.title: Service Operations Manager
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE The Service Operations Manager is responsible for the reliable, continuous delivery of production monitoring and identity & access management services across LeoVegas. The role combines people leadership of a shift-based engineering team with operational ownership of access governance, ensuring both functions run with consistency, discipline, and clear escalation paths. This is a people-first leadership role. The manager owns team health, shift rhythm, process adherence, and cross-functional coordination, serving as the primary operational liaison between Service Operations and the rest of the Technical Operations department. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: Operational leadership & shift management - Own the day-to-day running of a 24/7 shift-based monitoring operation, ensuring handovers are structured and documented. - Maintain shift coverage, manage rota planning, and oversee escalation readiness at all times. - Act as the primary point of escalation for shift engineers during major incidents, supporting war room coordination and live documentation. - Ensure production monitoring activities align with agreed SLAs, detection standards, and escalation procedures. - Review and continuously improve shift handover quality, ensuring knowledge transfer between rotations. Identity & access management oversight - Oversee the onboarding and offboarding process for all company employees, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant access provisioning. - Ensure periodic access reviews are completed on schedule across all managed systems. - Maintain compliance with internal access policies and relevant regulatory requirements (MGA, UKGC, SPA, and others as applicable). - Act as the accountable owner for access governance, working with the Identity & Access Analysts to continuously improve procedures. Cross-functional coordination - Serve as the primary interface between Service Operations and the Incident Management function, ensuring events are correctly escalated, classified, and handed over. - Coordinate with Change Management on maintenance windows, PR reviews, and go-live readiness activities. - Work closely with the Observability & Engineering Manager to surface operational pain points, monitoring gaps, and manual toil that require tooling or automation investment. - Participate in new market and provider onboarding processes, maintaining checklists and ensuring regulatory notification requirements are met. People & performance management - Lead regular 1:1s, performance conversations, and development planning for all direct reports. - Manage team wellbeing and engagement, with particular attention to the challenges of shift-based working patterns. - Identify training needs and support certification or skills development where appropriate. - Onboard new team members effectively, maintaining and improving onboarding documentation. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As an Applied Engineering Intern, you will work closely with our Applied AI Engineering team to facilitate the adoption of Mistral AI products among customers and collaborate with them to address complex technical challenges. This role is based in Paris, with an internship duration of 6 months. We are open to CIFRE programs as a continuation after the internship. What you will do • Contribute to the deployment of state-of-the-art GenAI applications, driving technological transformation with our customers. • Collaborate with researchers, AI engineers, and product engineers on complex customer projects. • Work with the product and science team to continuously improve our product and model capabilities based on customer feedback. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week. - Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before - We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care. - No politics. Low ego, high standards. - We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it. Ideally you have: • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch. • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and Linux shell environment. • Experience working in HPC Environments • Publication record in AI or a related field Location & work authorization: This internship is available only in France. Please apply only if you have the required work authorization to complete the internship in the relevant country for its full duration. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. As a member of the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who embeds directly with our most strategic customers to drive transformational AI adoption. You will collaborate closely with customer teams to ship advanced AI applications that solve real world business problems. Our FDEs engage with customers to accelerate the adoption of existing products and create new applications built on our models. Working closely with our Post-Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll combine engineering expertise, an understanding of frontier AI applications, and customer-facing skills to understand customer workflows and develop innovative solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability. You will sit at the frontier of enterprise AI deployments and serve as one of our founding FDEs who helps to shape our forward-deployed motion. We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive under ambiguity, and represent Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. This is a significant responsibility: you’ll play a key role in championing our mission in the enterprise. Responsibilities Work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, ensuring that these products meet customer requirements. Deliver technical artifacts for customers like MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills that will be used in production workflows. Provide white glove deployment support for Anthropic products in enterprise environments. Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams. Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks. Build long term relationships with customers and proactively identify new opportunities for AI deployment throughout the lifecycle of an engagement. Travel frequently (25-50%) to customer sites to build in person with customers. Be a champion for Anthropic’s mission in the field. You May Be a Good Fit If You Have 4+ years of experience in a technical, customer facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, or as a Software Engineer with consulting or product experience. Former technical founders are also encouraged to apply. Production experience with LLMs including advanced prompt engineering, agent development, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale. Strong programming skills with proficiency in Python (and ideally in one or more additional languages like TypeScript, Java, etc) and experience shipping production applications High agency with an ability to navigate ambiguity present in complex organizations. High cooperation mindset for cross-organizational collaboration, balancing competing priorities with integrity. Passion for advancing safe, beneficial AI systems through creative technical applications. Strong communication skills to conduct discovery with customers and to convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders while maintaining a low ego and collaborative approach. A background in financial services, healthcare/life sciences, or another enterprise vertical is a plus. Experience with enterprise IT systems and/or AI deployment patterns is a plus. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £225,000 — £255,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: B2B Marketing Manager, DACH
items.description: About the Team Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption. The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership. DACH is one of OpenAI’s most important markets in EMEA. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI. About the Role As the B2B Marketing Manager for DACH, you will own the integrated B2B marketing strategy and execution for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption. You will carry clear pipeline goals and be accountable for Marketing’s measurable contribution to commercial outcomes in DACH. These goals will be established through the regional planning process and will evolve with the priorities and maturity of the market. You will be expected to understand the pipeline, make informed investment decisions, and demonstrate how marketing activity creates, influences, or accelerates revenue opportunities. This is a generalist role spanning field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based programs, content, customer marketing, partnerships, events, and product launches. You will bring these channels together into a focused DACH B2B plan, drawing on specialist capabilities within the EMEA B2B Marketing team in London and global Marketing teams. A particularly important partnership will be with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead: together, you will align market strategy, narratives, launches, audience priorities, channels, and major moments so B2B and B2C activity is coordinated, complementary, and mutually reinforcing. Close partnership with Marketing Operations will be crucial. Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next. The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed. This role is preferably based in Munich. Berlin may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Regular travel within DACH and to London will be required. In this role, you will: - Own and execute the integrated DACH B2B marketing plan, aligned with regional priorities, local revenue goals, market opportunities, and customer needs. Partner closely with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead to ensure B2B and B2C strategies and activities are coordinated and complementary, while retaining clear accountability for B2B pipeline and revenue outcomes. - Carry pipeline goals for DACH B2B marketing and be accountable for demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline creation, influence, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes. - Partner closely with DACH Sales and GTM leadership on territory planning, target-account prioritisation, pipeline goals, strategic opportunities, and quarterly business reviews. - Build full-funnel programs across field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, content, customer advocacy, partnerships, events, and digital channels. - Design programs around priority accounts and buying groups, tailoring narratives and engagement for senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—and connecting customer proof, partner participation, content, and seller follow-up to create or advance opportunities. - Work in close partnership with Marketing Operations to define target audiences, establish campaigns, maintain data and process quality, track performance, improve attribution, and turn results into clear recommendations. - Build a regular Sales, Marketing, and Marketing Operations pacing rhythm covering pipeline performance, account engagement, campaign conversion, opportunity follow-up, risks, and investment decisions. - Translate global campaigns, product launches, narratives, and assets into locally relevant programs that reflect DACH market dynamics, language, industry priorities, and customer expectations. - Work with EMEA specialist teams in London to bring the strongest regional capabilities into the market, while serving as the voice of DACH in regional planning and prioritisation. - Develop locally relevant customer stories and advocacy opportunities in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Comms, and senior customer stakeholders. - Build joint programs with strategic technology, consulting, and implementation partners where they can extend reach, strengthen customer value, or contribute to pipeline. - Own the operating rhythm for DACH B2B marketing, including planning, budget management, agency coordination, campaign pacing, performance reporting, and prioritisation. - Build repeatable playbooks and share market learning across EMEA, helping the wider organisation understand what resonates with DACH customers and decision-makers. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 12+ years of experience in integrated B2B, regional, field, demand generation, or account-based marketing, ideally in enterprise technology, cloud, AI, or SaaS. - Have a proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through integrated B2B marketing programs, ideally within large, complex enterprise sales cycles. - Have supported high-value products with long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and significant commercial scrutiny, and are familiar with engaging senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—throughout complex buying journeys. - Have held pipeline goals or comparable commercial targets and can clearly demonstrate how your marketing decisions created, influenced, or accelerated revenue opportunities. - Have partnered closely with enterprise sellers and Sales leadership on account prioritisation, pipeline reviews, opportunity acceleration, executive engagement, and follow-up. - Have worked closely with Marketing Operations on campaign architecture, segmentation, lead and account processes, measurement, attribution, and performance reporting. - Are comfortable using pipeline and campaign data to diagnose performance, make trade-offs, and redirect investment—not simply report activity. - Are a marketing generalist with experience connecting multiple channels into one coherent market plan, rather than operating within a single specialist discipline, and have a strong track record of partnering with consumer marketing leaders to integrate B2B and B2C strategy and activity without blurring ownership. - Understand DACH enterprise buying dynamics and can translate local customer, industry, cultural, and regulatory context into stronger marketing decisions. - Can balance local market needs with regional and global priorities, influencing effectively within a matrixed international organisation. - Are both strategic and hands-on: able to establish direction and operating structure while personally driving high-priority work to completion. - Bring strong commercial judgement, operational discipline, and the ability to make clear prioritisation decisions when opportunities exceed available capacity. - Communicate credibly with senior customer decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—as well as Sales, Marketing, and partner stakeholders. - Are energised by AI and motivated to help organisations across DACH adopt transformative technology responsibly. - Are fluent in German and English. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. items.title: Marketing Lead
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? Are you obsessed with creator distribution, affiliate economics and the deals that put a brand in front of millions? Do you thrive with a blank page, where there’s no incumbent to copy and no playbook to inherit? If you’re dialled in on internet culture and crypto communities and you want the scope to build a brand from near-zero, this is a real opportunity to join one of Australia’s fastest growing tech companies, working across the world’s most talked about products. What you’ll build with us: This role owns affiliate and creator distribution end to end for a new betting product on our roadmap. You’ll own the partner base and the commercial terms behind it: recruitment, revenue-share structures, tooling and performance management, plus the YouTube, X and streaming partnerships that put the product in front of a crypto-native audience. You’ll also own the acquisition funnel and the P&L underneath it, so every dollar is attributable and every call is defensible. You’ll inherit real advantages: a founder-backed product, a strong engineering bench, and access to one of the most effective creator distribution networks in the world through our existing brands. What you won’t inherit is a playbook. The edge on offer here is scope — building at a scale most marketers never touch, with the resources to actually do it. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify, Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Own one of our affiliate and creator programmes end to end – recruitment, commercial terms, revenue-share structures, tooling and performance management of the partner base Sign and scale YouTube, X and streaming partnerships with crypto and internet-culture creators, from long-form YouTube integrations through to always-on affiliate relationships Negotiate deals that hold up commercially – you’ll model the economics, not just do the deal Build the distribution flywheel deliberately, including where we can leverage our existing creator ecosystem, while making sure the product lands as its own brand with its own audience Own the full acquisition funnel and the P&L behind it – budget, channel mix, CAC, deposit conversion and payback Build and scale acquisition across the channels that actually work for a crypto-native audience Set the measurement stack with BI and product analytics so every dollar is attributable and every decision is defensible Partner with CRM to build the onboarding, activation and retention journeys that turn a first deposit into an active player, and know which cohorts are worth reactivating and which aren’t Set and enforce the standards our affiliates and creators market to – their content is our brand and our regulatory exposure Your track record: Significant demonstrated experience leading affiliates, partnerships or growth for a high-growth consumer product Proven track record building and scaling affiliate programmes and creator or influencer partnerships, with YouTube partnerships specifically a strong advantage Genuine fluency in the crypto space – you understand the culture, the channels and the community, and you can tell the difference between real signal and noise Commercial ownership of a marketing budget with hard accountability for CAC, LTV, payback and revenue Strong analytical capability – comfortable in the data, able to interrogate attribution and make a call under uncertainty Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to sell a strategy to an executive audience and a partnership to a creator Commercially ruthless – every channel, creator and deal earns its place in the mix, you kill what isn’t working fast and you can show the numbers behind the call Straight about risk – you understand that credibility is the growth strategy, you market honestly and you hold every partner to the same line Bonus points if you also have: Knowledge of iGaming, sports betting or casino environments and their affiliate economics Experience marketing high-risk products in a restricted-advertising environment Experience taking a product to market internationally across multiple jurisdictions and licensing regimes Additional language skills Tertiary qualifications in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field Here are our benefits and perks: Sharpening your edge The ultimate sandbox. Exciting, on-the-job learning opportunities. 1 in 3 of our people level up their roles every year. If you deliver, you move. Competitive pay and bonus scheme Market-synced pay that respects your craft and location. Performance-based bonus recognition based on your impact (up to 20%). Help us build our crew and get paid for it with our high-value referral bonus. Because great people know great people. Other perks 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers Smooth Parental Return: Ease back into work with 12 weeks of transition support, including fully paid Fridays off during your first three months back Access to Employee Assistance Program Wednesday massages In-house baristas serve you free coffee, fresh juices and smoothies. Daily catered breakfast and regular company-wide events. Snack walls and drink fridges on every floor. Fun, modern office spaces. Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles and an F1 simulator. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Sales Development Leader - Tokyo
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s Enterprise Go-To-Market organization helps the world’s largest companies adopt and scale our AI platform across their business—from ChatGPT Enterprise to our developer platform and APIs. In Japan, we partner with leading organizations across industries including Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences, Retail, and Technology to build new AI-powered customer experiences, transform operations, and reimagine how work gets done. As adoption accelerates through pilots, experimentation, and developer-led use cases, the GTM team turns that momentum into durable, enterprise-wide deployments. Sales Development sits at the front of this motion—where technical curiosity becomes executive engagement and OpenAI’s enterprise relationships begin. ABOUT THE ROLE We are hiring a Sales Development Manager, Japan to lead and develop a team of SDRs supporting our enterprise business in Japan. Reporting into Sales Development leadership, this role will be responsible for coaching and developing a high-performing team focused on generating qualified pipeline and creating strategic opportunities across some of Japan’s largest and most influential organizations. This is a foundational front-line leadership role within OpenAI’s Japan GTM organization. You will help define how we engage prospective customers in the Japanese market, convert product and developer interest into enterprise conversations, and build repeatable outbound and inbound motions that reflect the unique dynamics of enterprise selling in Japan. You will partner closely with Japan Sales leadership, Account Directors, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, and Strategy & Operations, while connecting our Japan go-to-market motion with OpenAI’s broader regional and global strategy. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Lead, coach, and develop a team of SDRs supporting Large Enterprise, Strategic Accounts, and key industry verticals across Japan - Drive high-quality pipeline generation through outbound prospecting, inbound qualification, account-based motions, and product-led signals - Build an SDR motion tailored to the Japanese enterprise market, including thoughtful account mapping, stakeholder engagement, and long-term relationship development - Establish strong operational rigor around activity metrics, conversion rates, pipeline quality, and execution consistency - Partner closely with Account Directors and Japan sales leadership on territory planning, account prioritization, and strategic opportunity development - Help define scalable SDR playbooks across outbound, inbound, ABM, partner-sourced, and product-led motions - Coach SDRs on executive communication, discovery, account research, strategic prospecting, and engaging senior stakeholders within large Japanese enterprises - Build a high-performance, collaborative, and low-ego team culture focused on continuous improvement - Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Partnerships, Solutions Engineering, and Strategy & Operations to optimize pipeline generation efforts in Japan - Support the hiring, onboarding, and development of SDR talent as the Japan organization continues to scale - Bring insights from customers, prospects, and the Japanese market back into the broader APAC and global GTM organization YOU MAY THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have 6–10+ years of experience in sales, business development, or GTM roles, with significant experience in the Japanese market - As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world. Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy. We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone. Your Next Destination Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain, the UK, or the UAE. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first. Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact. For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home. 🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one. Many people joining us from the UAE are looking for clarity in scope and real ownership in their role. They want to know what they're responsible for, how success is measured, and have direct access to the people making decisions. What often stands out is the combination of a global, product-led company with a flexible remote setup. For many, it's the opportunity to work on a product used by millions of travelers worldwide, alongside a team that moves quickly and values clear ownership and accountability. items.title: Strategy & Operations Lead — Korea
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The APAC team is responsible for bringing OpenAI’s mission, products, and partnerships to life across one of the company’s most strategically important regions. As we scale our presence across Asia-Pacific, we are building a regional operating model that enables strong local execution, consistent global alignment, and long-term impact across businesses, products, markets, and functions. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Lead to lead and scale operational excellence in Korea. Reporting to the General Manager, Korea, this leader will work hand in hand with the General Manager to translate global strategy into regional execution, ensure operating discipline across markets and functions, and help the business scale with consistency, speed, and rigor. This person will act as a key bridge between global leadership and regional teams, bringing clarity to priorities, building scalable operating systems, and ensuring the region is set up to deliver against ambitious business goals while keeping the long-term opportunity in mind. This role is based in Seoul, Korea and we use a hybrid model of 3 days in office. YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Defining and implementing the Korea operating strategy in alignment with APAC & global objectives and regional priorities. - Driving execution across key markets, ensuring consistency while adapting to local needs, regulations, and market dynamics. - Partnering with global leadership to prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and ensure strong execution in-region. - Establishing KPIs, reporting frameworks, and operating cadences to track performance and inform decision-making. - Building and optimizing scalable processes across business lines, including consumer, product, partnerships, and other key functions. - Identifying operational gaps and inefficiencies, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. - Supporting market entry strategies and operational readiness for Korea - Enabling strategic partnerships through strong operational frameworks and close partnership with relevant teams. - Helping build a strong regional functional leadership team and ensuring the regional operating system runs smoothly and efficiently. - Collaborating closely across functions to drive accountability and deliver against regional goals. - Ensuring seamless coordination between global and regional stakeholders. - Acting as a central point of accountability for operational delivery across Korea. - Building, leading, and mentoring a high-performing regional operations team. - Fostering a culture of accountability, inclusion, operational rigor, and continuous learning. - Developing leadership bench strength across key markets and functions. WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WITH: - Significant experience leading regional or international operations in a fast-scaling, complex business environment. - Strong strategic and operational judgment, with the ability to translate high-level goals into clear execution plans. - Experience operating across multiple markets, functions, and business lines, ideally within Korea. - A track record of building scalable operating systems, processes, metrics, and reporting frameworks. - Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across global and regional teams. - Excellent business judgment, with a bias toward action and strong accountability for outcomes. - Experience supporting market expansion, operational readiness, and/or regional growth initiatives. - Strong people leadership skills, including experience building and developing high-performing teams. - Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating structure in fast-moving environments. - High integrity, low ego, and a collaborative leadership style. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bring clarity to complex topics. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. items.title: Sponsorship Manager
items.description: On average it takes 5 minutes to apply for this role. Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation. Do you see yourself as one of those “out-of-the-box thinkers”, “Technical masterminds”, “Outstanding creatives”, or “Mind-boggling number crunchers”? If so, we want to welcome you to the Betway family and celebrate what makes you unique! Our global customer base is exploding and we need your skills to support us on this exciting journey! Don’t look back and submit your application before the opportunity passes you by.. Who we are We’re Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands, including Betway and Jackpot City. We’re a powerhouse built on decades of expertise and we’re changing the game for good. Our mission is to give our customers a superclass entertainment experience. Who we’re looking for We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Super Group International, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish and your career can soar. Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary. Why we need you We’re building experiences that wow our customers – and that starts with bold, curious people who want to do work that matters. If you’re hungry to grow, excited by impact and ready for a challenge that will supercharge your career, this could be your moment. As Sponsorship Manager , you will implement the global football sponsorship strategy and create integrated campaigns that appeal to existing and prospective customers. You will manage a team of Sponsorship Account Leads and maximize every opportunity to promote the brand with multiple activation campaigns, driving innovation and business growth. What you’ll do Key Responsibilities Outline and lead the activation strategy and performance of your portfolio and implement the global sponsorship strategy Regularly monitor, review and report on the performance of the partnerships and ensure that it is delivering against the overall business objectives Assist in the negotiation and contractual processes of partnership and sponsorship deals Make recommendations on new commercial opportunities as well as exit plans, where appropriate Ensure sponsorship and marketing activities are compliant and follow external and internal legal and marketing regulations Manage Account Leads to complete the day-to-day operational requirements; from campaign management to execution and reporting- ensuring all rights are delivered, activated and tracked Proactively develop the skill sets of the team members to take full ownership of their portfolio Work with wider Brand, Digital & Country teams to identify new ways to integrate and maximise our partnerships rights Present sponsorship activations and campaign reports internally at a mid and senior level Manage the day-to-day relationships with agencies and suppliers across your portfolio, to ensure campaigns are executed and delivered against KPIs Develop long-term strategic relationships with sponsors and partners, as well as internal stakeholders Maintain strong understanding of the ever-changing landscape across your portfolio, with an in-depth understanding of competitor activity across the global sponsorship landscape Ensure the activation strategy is delivered within budget and continuously look for efficiencies. Manage day-to-day budget operations across your team and portfolio, including SOWs, POs and Invoices Maintain and apply knowledge of sports betting markets, including betting products, and emerging industry trends, to support informed decision-making, ensure regulatory compliance, and drive commercial performance through our partnerships This list covers your core responsibilities – with plenty of room to stretch, explore and take on new challenges as we grow. What you’ll bring You’re someone who brings: Demonstrate strategic ability and commercial thinking Analytic competency to review all existing and new sponsorships Previous relevant experience within brand marketing and sponsorship leveraging, preferably within the betting and/or football industries Strong experience and competency in all marketing disciplines (ATL, BTL, Digital, Experiential, Media, Social) Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills. Proven experience of working with multiple stakeholders internally and externally Strong experience in delivering & devising multi-platform branding & engagement activation strategies Devising & pitching activation strategies for consumer campaigns and events Demonstrable ability to overcome obstacles and be proactive in finding creative solutions Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail Previous Leadership experience Desirable skills you’ve got up your sleeve It would be great if you also have some the following skills: Knowledge of sports betting markets, including odds, betting types and market trends Previous experience in the online gaming or casino industry, with a strong understanding of player behaviour and industry regulations Familiarity with gambling regulations and compliance requirements in various jurisdictions, ensuring adherence to legal standards Our values are non-negotiables Our culture is underpinned by core values that are linked to key behavioural competencies. Along with the below behavioural competencies, these are essential for all employees in order for you to embed in and drive our culture forward. These competencies are: Adaptability Ownership and accountability Attention to detail Resilience Team orientation Integrity Innovation What you’ll get back We invest in your growth and wellbeing, so you can bring your best: Supergrowth is real here. Our learning and development programmes give you the tools, training and opportunities to level up fast. Your progress matters . Our Performance tool ensures you get meaningful feedback to support your development and superdrive your career. Support that has your back . Our Employee Assistance Programme offers resources for you and your family. Vitality Health Care Unum Dental Life Assurance & Income Protection Tusker car scheme Cycle to Work Retail discounts Ready to feel superclass? At Super Group, your experience matters. We’re honest, fair, and focused on helping you succeed – and your work will have real impact from day one. Game on! Should you not hear from us within 2 weeks, please assume your application has not been successful.
