items.title: Doctorant·e CIFRE Data Science Personnalisation et Jeu Responsable F/H
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic est un acteur européen majeur du pari sportif et du jeu en ligne, proposant des activités de paris sportifs, de poker, de courses hippiques et de casino sur plusieurs marchés. Notre mission est de faire grandir la passion du sport et du jeu en proposant une expérience de divertissement innovante, dans un environnement sécurisé et responsable. Avec environ 1 600 collaborateurs répartis dans cinq pays et un siège basé à Bordeaux, Betclic est une entreprise internationale, moderne et profondément technologique. Chez Betclic, la Data n’est pas une fonction support : des dizaines de modèles et de produits data tournent en production et contribuent directement à l’expérience de millions de joueurs. Vous rejoindrez une équipe Data Science de plus de dix personnes, dont quatre docteurs, qui travaille au quotidien avec les équipes Produit, Engineering, MLOps et Jeu Responsable. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 Cette opportunité combine un programme de recherche ambitieux avec un environnement industriel concret : • Une thèse CIFRE de 3 ans avec un CDI dès l’embauche • Un sujet de recherche directement lié au jeu responsable et à des décisions produit concrètes • Des données comportementales et transactionnelles à grande échelle, des systèmes de recommandation en production et un environnement d’expérimentation • Un environnement international et créatif dans lequel la Data Science a un impact visible • Un accès à Claude et une culture encourageant l’usage responsable de l’IA générative pour la recherche, le prototypage, l’analyse et la rédaction ENTER THE GAME 🎮 En tant que doctorant·e CIFRE, vous rejoindrez l’équipe Data Science de Betclic et travaillerez sur un sujet à l’intersection de la modélisation séquentielle, de la personnalisation, des sciences comportementales et du jeu responsable. La thèse sera menée en partenariat avec le laboratoire IMS Bordeaux et l’ENSC Bordeaux INP. Le ou la doctorant·e sera inscrit·e à l’école doctorale Sciences Physiques et de l’Ingénieur (SPI) de l’Université de Bordeaux. La question centrale est la suivante : comment comprendre ce qu’un joueur cherche à faire à un instant donné, plutôt que seulement ce qu’il a aimé dans le passé, afin d’adapter son expérience en temps réel tout en donnant la priorité à sa protection ? YOUR RO LE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 Le sujet de thèse proposé est : « De la pertinence de l’item au pilotage de l’expérience : comprendre l’état de session d’un joueur pour personnaliser l’expérience en temps réel, sous contraintes de jeu responsable. » Le sujet sera précisé avec le ou la candidat·e retenu·e et le laboratoire académique avant le dépôt du dossier auprès de l’ANRT. Vos travaux de recherche s’articuleront autour de trois objectifs complémentaires : • Estimer un état de session latent à partir de séquences d’événements incomplètes, en tenant compte de l’incertitude et des changements de régime comportemental. • Dépasser le simple classement d’items et étudier une politique d’adaptation au niveau de l’expérience, capable de choisir entre plusieurs actions : recommander, informer, favoriser la découverte, ou ne rien pousser. • Intégrer le jeu responsable comme contrainte prioritaire de la décision, à partir de signaux précoces, incertains et évolutifs observés au cours de la session. Le travail s’appuiera sur la comparaison de deux environnements contrastés, les paris sportifs et le Casino, ainsi que sur un accès direct à des systèmes en cours de déploiement en production. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 Nous recherchons une personne curieuse et rigoureuse, qui apprécie les problèmes ouverts et souhaite relier recherche scientifique et impact concret. • Vous êtes titulaire, ou bientôt titulaire, d’un Master 2 ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur en statistiques, mathématiques appliquées, Data Science, Machine Learning, informatique, cognitique ou dans un domaine proche. • Vous êtes récemment diplômé·e ou disposez d’une à deux années d’expérience en industrie en Data Science, Machine Learning, R&D ou analyse de données, et souhaitez vous engager dans une thèse. • Vous avez une réelle appétence pour les statistiques, la modélisation et l’analyse de données comportementales. • Vous êtes intéressé·e par la cognition, les intentions, les comportements humains ou les interactions entre individus et systèmes numériques. • Vous savez formuler des hypothèses, construire un protocole expérimental et interpréter rigoureusement des résultats. • Vous êtes à l’aise avec Python et disposez de bonnes bases en SQL. • Vous communiquez clairement avec des interlocuteurs scientifiques, techniques et métier. • Vous êtes autonome, curieux·se, rigoureux·se et appréciez le travail collaboratif. Une expérience ou des connaissances en recommandation, personnalisation, modèles séquentiels ou probabilistes, états latents, quantification de l’incertitude, évaluation de systèmes adaptatifs, sciences cognitives ou jeu responsable seront appréciées. Une appétence pour le sport, le gaming ou les environnements produits est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 Si votre candidature est présélectionnée, vous aurez d’abord un échange avec les Ressources Humaines, puis un entretien avec le Head of Data Science consacré à votre parcours, vos motivations et au sujet de thèse. Vous échangerez ensuite avec les encadrants académiques lors d’un entretien scientifique, avant un dernier entretien RH. Le processus pourra être adapté au profil du ou de la candidat·e et à l’avancement du projet CIFRE. Le sujet présenté constitue une base de travail : vos intérêts scientifiques et vos premières propositions contribueront à construire le programme de recherche final avec Betclic et le laboratoire académique. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 • Un CDI dès l’embauche dans le cadre d’une thèse CIFRE de 3 ans • Une rémunération attractive positionnée au niveau d’un poste de Junior Data Scientist chez Betclic • Un double encadrement industriel et académique au sein d’une équipe Data Science expérimentée et collaborative • Des données réelles, des systèmes en production et un environnement d’A/B testing • 25 jours de congés payés et 10 jours de RTT • Une carte Ticket Restaurant® créditée de 11 € par jour, dont 6 € pris en charge par Betclic • Une mutuelle santé prise en charge à 100 % pour vous et vos enfants • 50 % de remboursement des transports en commun ou une indemnité annuelle de mobilité durable • Un modèle de télétravail hybride et l’accès à un large catalogue de formation • Des cours de sport sur site, des événements internes et des locaux avec rooftop et vue sur la Cité du Vin CDI basé à Bordeaux Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

items.title: Engineering Manager (TLM, Agents)
items.description: Perplexity is seeking a TLM (Tech Lead Manager) to lead and grow our highly driven Agents engineering team. The Agents team consists of AI/ML, backend, and full-stack engineers who collaborate to build delightful agentic experiences within our Comet ecosystem https://www.perplexity.ai/comet. Our vision is to empower our users with AI agents that can faithfully actualize their intent, however and wherever expressed, through open-ended interactions with the world. As the Agents TLM, you will bring AI expertise, sharp product intuition, and strong engineering management skills to advance the frontier of what agents can accomplish for our millions of devoted users. You will lead, grow, and support a team in solving many open problems in AI, including: - Designing AI agents to navigate the digital world and perform increasingly valuable units of work for our users; - Training action and decision models that determine, based on complex multimodal states, how to accomplish user-specified objectives; - Providing consistently excellent experiences across desktop, mobile, headless cloud, and other environments through flexible abstractions and frictionless backgrounding; - Developing permission architectures, payload classifiers, and other methods to implement secure-by-design agentic capabilities; - Designing optimal data representations and modes of interaction between agents and their environments; - and much, much more. RESPONSIBILITIES - Provide technical leadership across multiple layers of a rapidly growing product in the AI agents space. - Develop and leverage cutting-edge AI models, infrastructure, and browser technologies to advance the capability frontier and scale those capabilities for a rapidly growing userbase. - Exercise sharp technical & product intuition to guide the team’s system architectures and product roadmaps. - Drive product reliability, code quality, AI evaluation, testing, and maintenance for the broader team. - Oversee hiring, onboarding, and mentorship for a rapidly growing team. Develop rigorous interview pipelines and work closely with recruiting to source candidates. - Interface with the Perplexity co-founders to deliver strategic objectives that redefine what’s possible in the AI industry. QUALIFICATIONS - Strong foundational familiarity with the full AI product stack. - Proficiency in Python (bonus points for TypeScript, Go, and/or Rust). - Domain expertise in at least one of the following areas: - Context engineering and tool interfaces for frontier AI models - Post-training and reinforcement learning (particularly for multimodal models) - Browser technologies (CDP, Playwright, extension development, etc.) - Strong product intuition and taste for user experience excellence. - Strong background and hands-on technical experience with frontier models (the more relevant to open-world agents, the better). - Strong organizational skills for managing and delivering parallel technical projects; ability to guide highly-opinionated teams in making sound tradeoffs and prioritization decisions is critical. - Experience managing engineering teams, including recruiting, growing, and retaining high-caliber talent. - 8+ years of engineering experience, with at least 3 of those years as an engineering manager.

items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role Anthropic's Safeguards team is responsible for enforcing our policies, protecting users, and ensuring our platform is not misused. A large and growing share of Claude usage reaches customers through our cloud partners: Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. As the Enforcement Operations Lead for Multi-Cloud, you'll own how Anthropic detects, reviews, and acts on misuse across those surfaces, where the partner owns the customer relationship and often the data path. You'll build the operating model, partner agreements, and documentation that make enforcement on every cloud consistent, auditable, and fast. This role requires someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and capable of coordinating across teams and companies to break new ground and drive work to completion. This work is deeply cross-functional. You'll partner closely with our product managers, policy experts, Safeguards engineering, Legal, and the trust & safety and operations teams across our Cloud partners to maintain a consistent and safe enforcement ecosystem. Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. Key responsibilities Own the end to end enforcement lifecycle on partner surfaces, from detection and review through action, customer communication, and appeal Define enforcement paths for each partner's operating model, including how actions are requested, executed, and confirmed when the partner controls the account Manage SLAs for review, escalation, and action, and evaluate performance against them on an ongoing basis Develop and maintain SOPs and escalation guides for all enforcement workflows, ensuring consistency across clouds Establish red-teaming, Quality processes, and operationalize shared metrics Stand up paired investigations with partner threat intelligence teams, including case referrals, indicator sharing, and paging for high severity incidents Own enforcement metrics across partner surfaces and report them to Safeguards leadership, partners, and regulators Minimum qualifications Extensive experience in trust and safety operations, enforcement, threat intelligence, or a related field Have managed external partner or vendor relationships where you did not control the other side's systems or priorities Comfortable working across policy, legal, engineering, and operations teams to translate requirements into practical workflows Experience building enforcement programs from the ground up, including SLAs, escalation paths, and quality measurement Highly organized, with a track record of maintaining rigorous documentation and SOPs in fast-moving environments Clear and precise communication, both in writing and verbally, across technical and non-technical audiences, including partner executives Energized by the challenge of building scalable systems in an environment where not everything is already figured out Care deeply about the responsible deployment of AI and the role enforcement operations plays in that mission Preferred qualifications Direct trust & safety, abuse, or security operations experience at AWS, GCP, or Azure, or at a company that ships through their marketplaces Experience designing incident response or escalation processes that span more than one company Familiarity with data access controls, audit requirements, or privacy constrained review environments Experience with law enforcement referrals, regulatory reporting, or compliance programs Background in AI safety, content moderation, fraud, or abuse detection systems Comfort working with data and metrics to inform operational decisions and surface trends to leadership The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $285,000 — $330,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

We welcome specialists in mobile, frontend, or full-stack development; you can focus on the area where you have the most depth. items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking an Early Talent Technical Recruiter to build and scale our early-career technical talent pipeline. You will own full-cycle recruiting for university hiring across technical functions, partnering closely with engineering and business leaders to hire high-potential interns and new graduates who will help shape the future of Work AI. This is an opportunity to own the entire UR program and join a team that is actively reimagining how recruiting works. We expect our recruiters to use AI as a force multiplier, experiment with new approaches, turn successful practices into repeatable systems, and help make recruiting at Glean faster, more insightful, and more human. You will: Own full-cycle recruiting for university hiring, including internship and new graduate roles across engineering, data, product, security, and related technical functions. Partner with our Co-founders, hiring managers, and technical interviewers to translate hiring plans into clear candidate profiles, sourcing strategies, calibrated interview processes, and timely decisions. Build year-round relationships with target universities, student organizations, faculty, career centers, and relevant technical communities to create durable, diverse pipelines. Plan and execute high-impact campus and community programs, including career fairs, information sessions, technical events, student outreach, and interview days. Source, assess, engage, and close early-career technical talent, using structured interviews and a high-touch candidate experience from first interaction through offer acceptance. Use recruiting data to monitor funnel health, conversion, candidate experience, and source effectiveness; recommend and implement improvements to increase quality, speed, and equity of outcomes. Partner with Recruiting Operations, People, and program stakeholders to deliver a seamless intern and new graduate experience, including onboarding and return-offer processes. Bring market insight to hiring teams on early-career technical talent, university ecosystems, competitive landscape, and candidate motivations. About you: 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with meaningful ownership of university, campus, early-career, or technical recruiting programs. Experience recruiting for technical talent, with the ability to understand and communicate core profiles across software engineering, data, security, product, or adjacent technical disciplines. Strong consultative partnership skills and a track record of influencing hiring managers through data, market insight, and sound judgment. Demonstrated ability to build inclusive, scalable sourcing strategies and develop trusted relationships with candidates and external university partners. Excellent program management skills, including the ability to manage multiple hiring cycles, events, and stakeholders with urgency and attention to detail. Fluency with applicant tracking systems, recruiting analytics, and sourcing tools. Clear, compelling written and verbal communication, with strong candidate advocacy and stakeholder-management skills. AI fluency and curiosity. You actively explore and apply AI tools to improve recruiting research, sourcing, candidate engagement, program operations, and decision quality, while using sound judgment around data privacy and candidate experience. Loca tion: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View office) Ability to travel up to 25%, with travel concentrated around campus recruiting seasons, career fairs, university events, and other early-career talent programs. Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $135,000 - $175,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants: Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement . By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement , and I agree to the terms.

items.title: Derivative Sales Analyst
items.department: Institutional Sales, Trading, and Prime Services
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Derivative Sales Analyst on the Institutional team, you'll own and grow relationships with Coinbase's top VIP derivatives traders, driving volume across futures, options, and perpetuals. You'll source new high-value traders from competitor venues, re-engage dormant accounts, and bring structured market and client insights back to Product, Risk, and Marketing to shape Coinbase Advanced trading offerings. What you'll do: Own and grow relationships with top VIP derivatives traders on Coinbase, driving increased trading volume, deepening engagement, and expanding adoption of advanced trading products. Source and convert new high-value derivatives traders from competitor venues through targeted outbound campaigns, market positioning, and relationship-building. Monitor derivatives market structure, client flows, and competitor offerings to identify upsell opportunities, inform pricing and product feedback, and deliver structured insights to Product, Risk, and Marketing. Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast for your book, reporting on key KPIs (volume, active traders, winbacks, competitor migration) and documenting client interactions through CRM tooling. Reactivate previously dormant top traders using data-driven tools and bespoke incentives to restore sustained volume. Build and refine AI-powered workflows for pipeline prioritization, client segmentation, and outreach personalization to scale coverage across your book. Required Skills and Experience: 2+ years of sales or business development experience in financial services, trading, or crypto, with a track record of hitting or exceeding revenue and volume targets. Demonstrated fluency in derivatives products (futures, options, perps) in traditional finance or crypto markets, evidenced by prior trading desk, brokerage, or exchange experience. Data-driven operating style with experience using dashboards, CRMs, and basic analytics to segment books, identify opportunities, and prioritize outreach. Background in business, finance, economics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience working directly with trading clients. Pre-existing network of active institutional derivatives traders you can bring to the platform on day one is preferred. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.title: B2B Communications Manager, LATAM
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence (AGI) benefits all of humanity. Achieving this goal requires more than cutting-edge research—it demands deep, ongoing engagement with the policymakers, communities, institutions, and partners shaping the future of AI. The communications team supports this mission by clearly and authentically explaining our technology, products, and approach, helping business leaders, customers, partners, developers, policymakers, and the public understand how AI can be developed and adopted responsibly. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a senior B2B Communications Manager for Latam, based in São Paulo, to shape how businesses across the region understand OpenAI’s technology, products, and role in helping organizations adopt AI responsibly. Reporting to the Head of Communications for LATAM, this role will own regional B2B communications strategy and execution, with a focus on helping business decision-makers, industry leaders, customers, partners, and the media understand the value and impact of OpenAI’s technology. You’ll shape how OpenAI communicates about enterprise adoption, customer outcomes, innovation, productivity, and responsible deployment across Latam markets. This is a builder role for someone equally comfortable setting regional strategy, developing compelling business narratives, and helping local teams translate global priorities into communications that resonate in their markets. You’ll partner closely with global Communications, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Product, Research, Safety, Legal, and Policy teams to deliver impact on the ground. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Set and execute the Latam B2B communications strategy, aligned with regional business priorities, global narratives, and OpenAI’s mission - Develop clear, compelling narratives that show how organizations across Latam can use OpenAI’s technology to transform work, improve productivity, build new products and services, and drive growth - Partner with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Product, Research, Safety, Legal, Policy, and global Communications teams to turn complex technology, product developments, and company announcements into locally relevant communications - Lead earned media strategy for B2B audiences across the region, including national, business, technology, and relevant industry and trade media - Identify and develop customer and partner stories that demonstrate credible, measurable business outcomes and responsible AI adoption across Latam - Prepare executives, customers, partners, and subject-matter experts for high-impact communications, including media interviews, industry events, launches, customer engagements, and moments of scrutiny - Build repeatable communications programs around enterprise adoption, customer milestones, partnerships, and go-to-market priorities across Latam, not just one-off announcements WHAT YOU BRING - 10+ years’ experience in B2B, corporate, product, or technology communications - Deep experience communicating enterprise technology, platforms, or technical products and translating complex capabilities into clear, accurate, and compelling business narratives - Strong earned media experience, with relationships across national, business, technology, and relevant industry and trade media - A strong understanding of the business, technology, and media landscape across Latam, including how enterprise adoption and customer needs vary by market - Proven experience partnering closely with marketing, sales, customer success, partnerships, product, research, safety, legal, policy, and communications teams - Experience operating at executive level and advising leaders through high-profile launches, customer moments, sensitive issues, and ambiguous environments - Excellent judgement and the ability to communicate confidently across business, product, corporate, policy, and societal topics - Experience working in international or regional roles within global companies and complex operating environments YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF - You like building from scratch and shaping how a company earns relevance and trust with business audiences - You have a thoughtful, audience-first mindset and go beyond traditional media relations to build understanding with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders - You are curious about how technology, business, policy, and society intersect across different markets - You care as much about customer credibility, trust, clarity, and accuracy as you do about reach - You are comfortable moving between regional strategy and the practical work needed to help local go-to-market teams succeed - You’re comfortable navigating complexity, scrutiny, and a fast-changing technology and business landscape - You want to work in a small, senior team where autonomy and judgement really matter About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance. items.description: On average it takes 5 minutes to apply for this role. Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation. Do you see yourself as one of those “out-of-the-box thinkers”, “Technical masterminds”, “Outstanding creatives”, or “Mind-boggling number crunchers”? If so, we want to welcome you to the Betway family and celebrate what makes you unique! Our global customer base is exploding and we need your skills to support us on this exciting journey! Don’t look back and submit your application before the opportunity passes you by.. Who we are We’re part of Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands. At Betway, we bring passionate people and innovative tech together to create market-leading online gaming solutions. Our multidisciplinary teams are passionate about products, customer experience and security. We’re empowered to achieve the ultimate in high-performance gaming experiences using the best technology available. Our International customer support teams, consist of specialist hosts who have knowledge and understanding of the customers within their specific regions. Customer welfare is forever at the forefront of our strategy at Betway. We want to ensure all of our customers enjoy our products in a safe and responsible gambling environment. Who we’re looking for We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Betway, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish and your career can soar. Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary. Why we need you We’re on a mission to create extraordinary experiences for our customers, and we believe that your unique skills, passion and superdrive will help us achieve our vision. As a Customer Service Host, you’ll be supporting the delivery of high-quality service within the contact centre covering, but not limited to, engaging with our customers through live chats, calls and emails, assisting them with their queries and/complaints. This will help us excel at providing world class service to stay ahead of the game. Due to the geographical locations we service, please note that this position entails shift work based on the requirements of the organization and its clients. What you’ll be doing As part of your role, your responsibilities will include: Providing world-class customer service by responding to customer queries by telephone, email, and online chats in first language Spanish and/ or second language being English where applicable Assist on tasks within other regions by using company translation tools provided, this is only if all tasks on the product that you are scheduled to work on have been completed. Processing and resolving of incoming and outgoing contacts in a multimedia environment Processing pertinent information into relevant databases Completion of tasks assigned during shift Customer relationship building and management as well as cross selling of products and services Problem solving tasks during shift Handling and taking full responsibility for customer related queries Excellent time management and adherence to schedule Performing extra tasks given by team managers as required This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities. Along with the below behavioural competencies, these are essential for all employees in order for you to embed in and drive our culture forward. These competencies are: Adaptability Ownership and accountability Initiating action Resilience Team orientation Integrity Innovation What you’ll get back We offer a great variety of personal and professional benefits to help you thrive at Betway and Super Group. Our comprehensive learning and development programmes give you a range of resources and opportunities to expand your skills and advance your career. Your hard work and achievements won’t go unnoticed. Our innovative Performance Tool ensures you receive regular, constructive feedback, helping you to continuously improve and reach your full potential. Our Employee Assistance programme offers a variety of benefits which you and your family can benefit from. Health Insurance Life Assurance Income protection Be part of that Superclass feeling. At Super Group, diversity is part of our DNA. With teams across 16 countries, 85 nationalities, and 20 languages, we take equal opportunities seriously, championing a supportive, inclusive and empowering environment wherever you are in the Group. It’s all about putting your experience first and ensuring honesty and fairness in all we do. Here, your growth is supported and your contributions valued. Game on! items.title: Technical Architect
items.location_text: Remote-Friendly (Travel-Required) | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude Code is changing how engineering organizations build software, and most of them need someone to show them how. That's you. Technical Architects help customers get real work done with Claude Code, Claude Tag (Claude Code as an agent in Slack), and the enterprise admin controls that decide whether a rollout succeeds. You'll teach customers, partners and Anthropic's own field teams. Just as important, you'll train the trainers who carry that knowledge to everyone else. We're hands-on AI engineers who would rather teach than sell. items.title: Research Engineer, AI for Chip Design
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI develops models that can reason through complex problems and hardware designed for the demands of advanced AI. AI for Chips connects these efforts: applying increasingly capable AI systems to the work of semiconductor engineering. Our goal is to help engineers develop better chips and shorten design cycles. This work brings research, model training, and hardware expertise together to build tools that engineers can use on real designs, with correctness and measurable performance at the center. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re hiring a Research Engineer to help OpenAI models solve chip-design problems through reinforcement learning, tool use, and evaluation. You’ll own experiments from the initial idea through implementation and analysis. That means building environments and evaluations, running training, investigating failures, and using the results to decide what to try next. You’ll also build the software needed to make those experiments reliable and reproducible. We value strong coding fundamentals, careful experimental judgment, and the ability to make progress independently. Prior chip-design experience is helpful, but you can learn the domain alongside the team’s hardware specialists. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Build RL environments and evaluations for tasks such as RTL generation, design verification, and physical design optimization. - Develop and test approaches that help models use chip-design tools and improve power, performance, and area while preserving correctness. - Design experiments, establish baselines, and measure whether improvements hold up on new tasks and designs. - Investigate failures across model behavior, rewards, evaluation tools, and experiment infrastructure. - Improve iteration speed through better tooling, faster evaluations, and proxy rewards that reflect the outcomes we care about. - Turn successful experiments into reusable research code and training workflows, working closely with researchers and engineers. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have strong programming and debugging skills and a track record of turning technical ideas into working software. - Experience with reinforcement learning, model evaluations, post-training, or other applied ML research. - Experience building tool-using agents, reward functions, or automated evaluation systems. - Can form clear hypotheses, design useful experiments, and distinguish meaningful results from noise or evaluation errors. - Work independently on ambiguous problems and make practical decisions about what to build or test next. - Stay close to the implementation and can explain what you built, what failed, and what you learned. - Communicate progress clearly and collaborate well with people across research, software, and hardware. - Care about developing safe, beneficial AI. NICE TO HAVE: - Familiarity with experiment orchestration, distributed training, or research infrastructure. - Experience with RTL, Verilog/SystemVerilog, EDA tools, formal verification, or chip-design automation. You'll partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Design to influence roadmaps with customer-grounded data, making these first-impression moments seamless. items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is looking for a Staff Android Engineer to help build a world-class trading app on Android. Millions of users follow markets, track positions, and make trades on their phones — and the Android experience needs to match that level of engagement. This is a high-ownership, high-influence role for someone who has operated at the staff level before and knows what it means to shape a platform, not just build on it. You'll set the technical direction for Android at Polymarket, raise the bar across the codebase, and help take a product that's already at scale to the next level. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Set the technical direction for Android at Polymarket, making and owning architectural decisions that the team builds around - Build and own Android features spanning payments flows, real-time market data, and core UI with full accountability from design handoff through to production - Implement polished, performant interfaces with Jetpack Compose that hold up under real trading conditions and meet a high bar for feel and reliability - Own CI/CD pipelines and Gradle configuration, keeping the build fast and the release process reliable as the team and product grow - Build and maintain integrations across WebSockets, gRPC, and streaming data to power the live market features traders depend on - Operate as a technical leader across a distributed team: communicate clearly, make decisions without hand-holding, and raise the engineering bar through code reviews and strong engineering standards - Actively incorporate AI tools into your development workflow to move faster and maintain a high output bar - Identify and address gaps in Android architecture and engineering practices before they become problems at scale WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Significant Android engineering experience, with a track record of owning and shaping Android platforms at scale, not just contributing to them - Strong, current expertise in Kotlin with the ability to speak concretely to tradeoffs and make architectural calls with confidence - Deep experience building production UI with Jetpack Compose and a high bar for performance and polish - Experience owning CI/CD pipelines and Gradle build configuration end-to-end - Solid understanding of modern Android architecture with the judgment to evolve it as the product scales - A track record of technical leadership: you've influenced how an engineering team works, not just what it ships - Active use of AI tools in your development workflow, not occasionally, but as a real part of how you work - (Plus) Experience integrating payments on Android - (Plus) Experience with WebSockets, gRPC, or other real-time data patterns on mobile - (Plus) Familiarity with cross-platform shared-code architectures - (Plus) iOS or Swift experience - (Plus) Background at a larger, more mature engineering organization where you saw and shaped practices as the company grew BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $250,000 to $500,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

items.description: About the Team OpenAI is building the next generation of advertising for an AI-powered world. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways. The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. We define how businesses discover OpenAI’s advertising platform, become successful advertisers, and grow their investment over time. Working closely with Product, Ads Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, we combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation, and fast execution to turn early opportunities into scalable growth. About the Role We are hiring a Lead, Ads Prospecting & Growth Intelligence to build the intelligence and orchestration platform powering OpenAI’s ads business. This person will help us identify the right companies and people, understand why they are relevant, determine the right next action, and learn from what happens afterward. Own the prospecting function for the ads business, serving SMB Ads while building a foundation reusable across segments. Set the vision, operating model, roadmap, platform choices, business rules, adoption, and outcomes; and partner with Ads Engineering, Data Science, and internal platform teams. Decide what to build in-house, enable through internal platforms, or deliver through selected vendors and partners. In This Role, You Will - Lead the function’s strategy, roadmap, operating model, and adoption. Connect platform investments to measurable advertiser and business outcomes. - Define a unified prospect, account, contact, and advertiser data model. Establish standards for identity, data quality, provenance, freshness, confidence, and consent. - Combine market, intent, behavioral, product, CRM, campaign, and customer-success signals to improve targeting and customer engagement. - Design enrichment and verification workflows. Evaluate in-house capabilities, platforms, vendors, APIs, AI, and human review to select effective solutions. - Develop scoring and next-best-action models using customer fit, intent, activity, reachability, lifecycle stage, and growth potential. - Connect intelligence to action across sales, marketing, product, paid media, partners, and lifecycle journeys through coordinated routing and activation. - Enable marketers to create audiences, configure triggered journeys, run experiments, and execute campaigns through intuitive systems with quality checks and approvals. - Build feedback loops that use outreach, engagement, conversion, spend, retention, churn, and customer-success outcomes to improve targeting and lifecycle decisions. - Measure data quality, coverage, targeting accuracy, deliverability, conversion, and incremental value. Establish permissions, suppression, auditability, and provider-performance standards. You Might Thrive in This Role If You - Bring substantial experience building go-to-market systems, customer-data products, growth platforms, lifecycle infrastructure, revenue systems, or marketing technology. - Demonstrate ownership of platforms that connect data, decisions, and workflows to measurable commercial outcomes. - Apply strong product judgment to prioritize opportunities, define useful solutions, and sequence delivery. - Translate identity resolution, enrichment, scoring, segmentation, routing, experimentation, and feedback loops into clear system requirements. - Design practical solutions with marketers and sales teams, grounded in their campaign and customer workflows. - Explore data and test ideas with tools such as analytics platforms, SQL, APIs, automation, or AI-assisted prototyping. Production engineering experience is not required. - Evaluate build, buy, and integration choices across CRM, marketing automation, customer data platforms, and campaign-execution systems. - Lead a small team and build alignment with senior cross-functional partners. - Apply sound judgment to privacy, consent, deliverability, data rights, governance, and customer trust. - Bring relevant experience in advertising, SMB or self-serve businesses, product-led SaaS, marketplaces, commerce, fintech, enterprise go-to-market, or other multi-segment customer journeys. Preferred Qualifications - Experience building prospecting or customer intelligence platforms for advertising, SMB, or self-serve businesses. - Track record combining customer and intent data to improve targeting and conversion. - Experience deploying enrichment, scoring, and next-best-action models across marketing and sales. - Experience integrating data vendors, CRM, marketing automation, and customer data platforms. - Hands-on experience using SQL, APIs, automation, or AI to validate growth solutions. - Experience building feedback loops and governance practices that improve performance, data quality, and trust. items.title: Senior Director, Solutions Architecture — Americas
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! As the Senior Director of Solutions Architecture for the Americas at Cohere, you will own the US and Canada commercial Solutions Architecture function. You will lead the team that turns enterprise interest in agentic AI into deployed, production systems, and you will be accountable for the technical win in the most competitive AI market in the world. The United States and Canada are our largest commercial opportunity, and this seat owns how we win them. You will take an established, distributed team of strong technical people and raise what it can do — setting the bar and establishing the operating rhythm that lets a team of generalists run consistent, industry-fluent plays at enterprise scale. You will set direction for the function, sit on the Solution Architecture leadership team alongside the regional leaders for EMEA and Asia Pacific, and contribute to company-wide decisions with your peers across Sales, Product and Engineering. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Lead and Scale the Organization: Build, coach and develop a high-performing Solutions Architecture organization across the US and Canada, and grow the senior technical talent within it. - Own the Technical Win: Be personally accountable for the technical outcome of the region’s most strategic pursuits, and be in the room for the ones that decide the year. - Own the US Market: Lead how Cohere positions, proves and sells into US enterprises — our largest commercial opportunity, and the market this seat is measured on. - Extend Our Reach: Grow the share of the region’s pipeline the team is technically leading, and make sure we are engaged early on the opportunities that matter most. - Own the Number with Sales: Partner with regional Sales leadership as a co-owner of the region’s number, not as a support function to it. - Set Direction for the Function: Define the vision, strategy and operating model for Americas Solutions Architecture, and hold your leaders accountable for delivery and execution against it. - Build Repeatable Solution Practices: Establish scalable solution-selling methodologies, industry playbooks, executive narratives, business cases and technical delivery frameworks that improve consistency and win rates. - Architect Enterprise AI Solutions: Guide customers in designing secure, scalable, production-ready agentic AI solutions across cloud, hybrid, VPC and on-premises environments. - Shape Product Direction: Partner closely with Product and Engineering to translate customer feedback and market needs into platform improvements and roadmap priorities. - Attract Talent to Cohere: Bring senior technical field talent with you and continue to attract it. Building the bench is part of the job, not a consequence of it. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Lead and develop the Americas commercial Solutions Architecture team through coaching, hiring, performance management and career development. - Partner with regional Sales leadership to pursue and close strategic enterprise opportunities across financial services, healthcare, energy, technology and other key verticals. - Own the region’s technical coverage model, and ensure the team is engaged early and consistently on the opportunities that matter most. - Lead executive workshops, discovery sessions, solution presentations and technical deep dives with C-suite and senior customer stakeholders. - Develop business cases, solution architectures, implementation roadmaps and technical proposals that align customer objectives with Cohere’s platform. - Guide customers through the deployment of enterprise AI solutions, ensuring scalability, security, governance and operational readiness. - Create repeatable solution assets, industry playbooks and best practices that enable the team to consistently deliver high-quality customer engagements. - Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales and Customer Success to ensure alignment between customer needs and platform evolution, and contribute to decisions that reach beyond your own function. - Serve as the voice of the field by capturing customer feedback and competitive insights that influence product strategy. - Own and report on the region’s operational and commercial metrics, including technical win rates, pipeline health, coverage and team performance. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR: - Leadership Experience: 15+ years in Solutions Architecture, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting or Enterprise Architecture, including 7+ years leading customer-facing technical teams, and a record of developing people into senior and leadership roles. - People Leadership: A proven record of hiring, coaching and developing high-performing Solutions Architecture or Solutions Engineering teams, and of building or transforming an organization rather than inheriting a healthy one. - Executive Presence: You command a room. You are credible in front of a CEO and their business leaders, the people who own the problem and the budget, and equally credible in front of a Chief Information Officer, a Chief AI Officer or a Chief Information Security Officer. You can move between the business case and the architecture without losing either audience. - Hands-On Technical Credibility: You are technical enough to be believed by a strong engineering bench. You work with models and agents yourself, you can pressure-test your team’s architecture, and you can be the most useful person in a design conversation when it matters. This is a player-coach seat, not an overlay. - Commercial Acumen: A demonstrated ability to partner with enterprise Sales leadership, influence strategic deals, and articulate business value to executive stakeholders. You have carried a number and can point to deals you personally moved. - Consulting Mindset: Experience leading complex enterprise solution engagements, developing business cases, implementation plans and executive-ready recommendations. - Technical Expertise: A strong understanding of modern AI architectures, including large language models, agentic systems, retrieval, enterprise integrations, cloud platforms, hybrid and on-premises deployments, security and governance. - Enterprise Experience: Experience designing and delivering enterprise technology solutions in complex, regulated or large-scale environments. - Cross-Functional Influence: A record of contributing to decisions beyond your own function, and of working effectively with Product and Engineering leadership. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: - Experience building or turning around a regional technical field organization, and evidence of what changed as a result. - Background in enterprise AI, cloud, or data platform companies, or applied AI consulting organizations. - Experience supporting customers in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, energy, or the public sector. - Experience building repeatable solution-selling methodologies and helping generalist technical teams operate at a consistently high level. - A network of senior technical field talent you can attract to Cohere. - Experience operating in high-growth environments where speed, ownership and cross-functional collaboration are critical. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. items.title: Senior Director, Integrated Marketing
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ABOUT THE ROLE Cohere builds frontier AI for the enterprise. We're hiring a Senior Director of Integrated Marketing to bring our demand engine, product marketing, and field/partner motion under one strategic roof. This is the senior marketing leader most accountable for pipeline. You're the person who turns Cohere's product, brand, and category narrative into qualified enterprise opportunities for our sales team. Sub-functions report to you: Product Marketing, Web Marketing, Growth, and Events & Partnerships. You'll work with the Chief of Staff on planning, budget, and operating cadence, and with the Marketing Operations Director and her analytics team on attribution, forecasting, martech, and the dashboards your pipeline number lives in. The demand engine only runs if you and the analytics group work as one team on measurement, and building that partnership is part of the job from week one. This role is built for someone who has done it before at a high-growth B2B SaaS or infrastructure company, and is ready to do it again at the frontier of AI. WHAT YOU'LL RUN Integrated marketing strategy - Build and run the integrated marketing plan against Cohere's annual pipeline and revenue targets, by segment (enterprise, mid-market) and by region (NA, EMEA, APAC, Japan). You'll build it with the Chief of Staff, who holds the planning calendar for the wider marketing org. You will carry the pipeline number for marketing Growth & demand generation - Manage the Growth lead across paid media, SEO, lifecycle/email, web conversion, ABM, and developer-led acquisition. Set the demand strategy with them: efficient pipeline from both top-of-funnel demand (broad-reach campaigns, content syndication, paid) and bottom-funnel ABM into our priority accounts. Product marketing - Manage the Product Marketing lead, whose team runs positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, pricing/packaging input, launches, and sales enablement. Partner with Product and Research leadership to translate frontier capability into language enterprise buyers actually care about: business outcomes, security, deployment flexibility, ROI. Events & partnerships marketing - Manage the Events & Partnerships lead as they build the partner marketing motion with our cloud, SI, and technology partners: co-marketing campaigns, joint field activity, partner-sourced pipeline. Hold events to a pipeline standard. Team leadership - Manage and develop three established leads as direct reports, plus their teams of ~[20–35] across the three sub-functions. - Set the operating cadence with the Chief of Staff: weekly pipeline reviews with Sales, monthly QBR-style reviews internally, quarterly planning with Finance and RevOps. HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED Primary: - Marketing-sourced pipeline ($ and # of opportunities) - Marketing-influenced pipeline - MQL → SQL conversion rate and velocity - Cost per opportunity / pipeline ROI Secondary: - Launch impact (pipeline generated within 90 days of major launches) - Event ROI (pipeline per event $) - Partner-sourced pipeline - ABM account engagement and penetration in named accounts - Sales team NPS / enablement satisfaction WHAT YOU BRING - 15-20+ years in B2B marketing, with at least 4–5 years leading multi-function marketing teams at a high-growth enterprise SaaS, cloud, data, or AI/ML company. - A demonstrable track record of owning a pipeline number, not just contributing to one. You can walk us through the campaigns, the math, and the trade-offs. - Experience managing across at least two of: demand gen / growth, product marketing, field/events, partner marketing. Bonus if you've covered three or more. - Fluency in the modern B2B marketing stack: Marketo or HubSpot, Salesforce, an ABM platform (6sense, Demandbase, or similar), and attribution tooling. Comfortable in a dashboard, not just a deck. - Experience marketing to technical buyers (engineering leaders, data/ML leaders, CIOs) and selling technical products. AI/ML, data infra, dev tools, or cloud experience strongly preferred. - Operating range: comfortable on a board-deck slide and on the floor of a trade-show booth in the same week. - Excellent cross-functional leadership, particularly with Sales, RevOps, Product, and Finance. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: Senior Cinematographer, Brand Studio
items.description: We’re looking for a Senior Cinematographer to define how Perplexity looks on film. Working with the Creative Director and Video Lead, you’ll translate our visual identity into a practical cinematographic language, then bring it to life across the team’s day-to-day output. This is a hands-on role. One day you’re shooting a candid office moment or executive interview with a small kit; the next, you’re leading a full camera and lighting crew on a brand film. Most of your time goes to prepping, testing, lighting, and shooting. You’ll also help build and run our in-house studio, from selecting gear and designing flexible lighting setups to keeping the space production-ready. When turnaround is tight, you’ll support media management and light editing. You’ll report to the Video Lead and work closely with the Video Producer, Brand Lead, designers, motion designers, Growth, Comms, Product Marketing, and external production partners. The Producer and Video Lead handle crewing, budgets, schedules, and logistics so you can stay focused on production and craft. However, you should think like a storyteller, not just a technician, bringing your own ideas for how to show our product and people more vividly through moodboards, shot lists, storyboards, and a willingness to experiment. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Partner with the Creative Director and Video Lead to define and evolve Perplexity’s cinematographic language, and turn it into repeatable approaches for lighting, lensing, composition, movement, and color. - Shoot and light a steady mix of day-to-day content: candid office moments, executive interviews, product demos, social, events, and documentary stories. - Lead cinematography on brand films, campaigns, partnerships, and launches. - Scale to the work: operate solo with a minimal kit, lead a small crew, or help build a full camera, lighting, grip, team (with help from producers). - Bring storytelling ideas to the table through moodboards, shot lists, storyboards, and experimentation. - Own camera, lighting, and movement decisions from creative development through capture: build packages, run tests and tech scouts, and solve constraints before the shoot. - Recommend crew and equipment for each production and lead the camera and lighting departments on set. Producers handle budgets, schedules, contracts, and logistics. - Help design, build, and run the in-house studio, including lighting, audio, grip, and monitoring. - Own the team’s gear: recommend, purchase, organize, and maintain it, with ready-to-shoot packages so no setup gets rebuilt from scratch. - Handle color grading in DaVinci Resolve, and support selects, stringouts, and light edits when turnaround is tight. - Keep the visual standard high across formats and crew sizes without overbuilding. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years as a cinematographer or DP across branded, commercial, documentary, and interview work. - A standout reel showing visual authorship, lighting craft, camera movement, and an eye for honest, unscripted moments. - A strong point of view, paired with the sensitivity to work within and strengthen an existing brand. - Deep command of camera systems, lenses, exposure, color pipelines, lighting, grip, and on-set monitoring. - Genuinely hands-on: equally comfortable building a camera, shaping light, operating, troubleshooting, and leading a crew. - The judgment to make premium images under real constraints, solo with a small kit or leading a full production. - Strong pre-production instincts: turning a creative idea into a technically sound, right-sized plan. - Experience briefing and leading freelance crews and vendors on set, and managing professional production equipment. - Working proficiency in DaVinci Resolve for color grading, selects, and light edits. - Collaborative and low-ego. You bring a strong opinion, take direction, and solve problems with partners. - Comfortable moving fast in an ambiguous, high-output environment without compromising craft, safety, or footage. - Based in or able to work on-site in San Francisco, with flexibility for travel and long shoot days. NICE TO HAVE - A strong Bay Area and Los Angeles network of camera, lighting, grip, sound, production, and rental partners. - Experience within an in-house brand studio at a technology or consumer company. - Strong documentary instincts and experience working with founders, executives, talent, or people who are not professional performers. - Experience with multi-camera interviews, live events, tabletop or product cinematography, motion-control systems, or virtual production. - Color-grading experience and a strong understanding of how capture decisions carry through finishing and delivery.

items.title: Applied AI Engineer, AI for Mistral
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As an Applied AI Engineer, your mission is to make Mistral AI-native from the inside. You lead the design and delivery of production-grade AI systems in rapid cycles, building the iconic use case for multiple department (eg: GTM, HR, Engineering, Finance, ect) in your portfolio. You sit where product, engineering and the business overlap, turning advanced technology into real-world solutions that move a metric. You translate complex, often ambiguous business requirements into engineered solutions that work at scale. You act as the technical lead for your departments and contribute as an Individual contributor you guide the technical choices, build the solution end to end, drive adoption, and keep improving it. Your goal is to build clients trust, and deliver high ROI solutions, not a hit-and-run POC. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Run discovery with department heads and key users, map their workflows, and turn ambiguous needs into a prioritized use-case backlog with clear expected value. - Deliver end to end: design and ship production-grade full-stack apps (Python/FastAPI, React) and AI systems, from scoping through deployment and adoption. - Encode business rules, KPIs and ROI metrics as durable datalake assets and app logic, so your departments run on trustworthy, observable data. - Dogfood the latest Mistral products as a first internal user, and turn what you learn into credible product feedback that shapes the roadmap. - Own architecture for your surface: keep it scalable, secure and observable, with a high bar on clean code. - Spot patterns across departments and lift one-off solutions into reusable building blocks. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - At least 3 years building and deploying production AI software. - Strong full-stack engineer: Python/TypeScript, scalable backends (FastAPI/Node), and enough frontend (React/Vue) to ship a usable app yourself. - Hands-on with modern GenAI use cases: RAG, agents, workflows, orchestration and evaluation. - Strong command of vibe-coding tools, paired with genuine care for clean code and architecture: speed without slop. - Strong ownership and a bias for delivery. This is made for high-velocity engineers who already have experience. - Fluent in AI-native tools (Slack, Linear, etc.). - Passionate about solving customer problems. Here, your customers are Mistral's own teams. - Excellent communication in fluent English: you can explain a technical idea to a lawyer, a marketer and a staff engineer in the same afternoon. NICE TO HAVE - Exposure to Legal, Public Affairs, Marketing or Compute/Infra domains, or a track record of getting fluent in an unfamiliar domain fast. - Data engineering or analytics experience (warehouse modeling, dbt, dashboards). - Contributions to open-source projects, especially around LLMs. - A builder's instinct for internal tooling and platform reuse. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.
